newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood says casino gets license.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood says casino gets license.

text.p: The Louisiana Gaming Control Board on Thursday voted unanimously in favor of granting Louisiana's fifteenth and final riverboat license to Hollywood/DeBartolo Entertainment Louisiana Llc, a statement issued by Hollywod Casino Corp said.
The company is owned on a 50/50 basis by affiliates of Hollywood Casino Corp and DeBartolo Entertainment.
Hollywood said it and DeBartolo competed against five other gaming companies for the license.
Hollywood/DeBartolo intends to construct the $194 million Hollywood Casino Resort at Cane's Landing in Bossier City, La., Hollywood said.
